What you’ll learn

  • Set up your business portfolio, ad account, payment settings and secure access.
  • Connect WhatsApp and build a campaign around a clear business offer.
  • Choose an audience, budget, schedule and creative you can test.
  • Check the customer journey, handle enquiries and review useful metrics.
  • Explore phone-call, website-traffic and Shopify-sales campaign scenarios.

Inside the course

01   Get the foundations right

Account setup and secure access, pages 2–3. Your campaign roadmap, page 4. Offer, goal and spending boundary, page 5.

02   Connect, build and create

WhatsApp connection, page 6. Campaign structure, page 7. Audience, budget and schedule, page 8. Ad creative and conversation starters, page 9.

03   Launch and improve

Test the complete journey, page 10. Handle enquiries, page 11. Measure useful results and decide what to change, pages 12–13.

04   Work through your own campaign

Launch checklist, page 14. Campaign brief, page 15. Enquiry tracker, page 16. First-test review, page 17.

05   Explore other business goals

Website tracking, page 18. Phone calls, website traffic and Shopify sales, pages 19–22. Troubleshooting, page 23. Official sources, pages 24–25.

Made for you if…

For business owners, service businesses and beginner marketers who want a structured first step into Meta advertising.

What’s included

  • A complete 25-page English PDF
  • Step-by-step setup and campaign lessons
  • Campaign brief, launch checklist and tracking worksheets
  • Business scenarios and official-source references

Before you begin

You will need an eligible Meta account and access to the business assets you use. Running ads requires a separate advertising budget. The core WhatsApp example does not require a website.

An independent Ascore course. Meta screens, policies and eligibility can change. Advertising results are not guaranteed. The 2026–2027 title identifies the edition, not verification of future features.
